title: Model switch sensitivity sampler and prioritization matrix
creator: Priya Nair
description: Build a repeatable analysis artifact and lightweight tool that simulates customer-facing impact for hypothetical model switches and produces a prioritized onboarding/fallback backlog. The goal is to translate market signals (new model releases, pricing changes, regional availability, benchmarks, and customer request volume) into a ranked list of models and model-variants to onboard or prepare as fallbacks, with clear latency/cost trade-off buckets and recommended instrumentation. This ticket covers scoping, data ingestion definitions, sampling heuristics, prototype scoring matrix, and handoff to engineering for automation.
deliverables: Design doc describing inputs and scoring rules (conservative & aggressive modes)
CSV sampler that runs 50 synthetic switch scenarios against 3 canonical customer workloads
Prioritization matrix (CSV + visual) with scores for: business risk, latency sensitivity, unit-cost delta, regulatory exposure, and integration effort
Roadmap ticket list (top 10 prioritized model onboarding/fallback actions)
acceptance_criteria: Prototype sampler runs end-to-end on staging data and outputs results for 3 workloads
Prioritization matrix includes at least 5 signal types (pricing, perf, adoption, enterprise requests, regulatory), with weights configurable in the doc
Stakeholder review recorded with sign-off from GTM, Solutions, and ML research
Handoff to ENG with clear API contract and sample data mapping
data_sources: internal: customer support and sales request tracker (Zendesk/HubSpot extracts)
external: public model release notes and advertised pricing (provider websites, ModelHub snapshots)
benchmarks: internal throughput & latency microbenchmarks, MLPerf-like community bench results
third-party signals: GitHub stars/commits trend, Hugging Face model downloads, Twitter/Reddit activity sample
comments: 2025-02-14: Kickoff meeting. Agreed canonical workloads = chat short, code-completion, long-form summarization.
2025-02-20: Collected first-pass cost deltas for 8 candidate models; noticed two new entrants with large price drops in EU region.
2025-02-25: Research produced perf outliers for long-seq summarization; flagged for additional microbenching (action: ENG-21890)
2025-02-28: First stakeholder review — GTM wants explicit customer migration scripts included in follow-up
2025-03-01: Updated scoring weights to upweight enterprise request volume after Solutions feedback
risks: Signal noise: public popularity signals may not map to enterprise readiness
Data lag: pricing or availability changes might be stale in feeds
Integration effort underestimation for models requiring custom tokenizers or quantization
next_steps: Finalize scoring rubric and publish design doc (owner: Priya)
Ask ENG to run 3 targeted microbenchmarks for flagged outliers (ticket: ENG-21890)
Instrument a lightweight nightly ingestion pipeline for external signals (follow-up ticket)
